title: Helpers at Home — Serving Our Family
memory_verse: "Serve one another humbly in love." — Galatians 5:13 (NIV)
objective: Students will learn how they can be helpers at home and serve their family like Jesus taught.
content: God wants us to be helpers! Jesus said that the greatest person is the one who serves others. We can start by helping at home!
There are many ways to help at home. You can pick up your toys, make your bed, help set the table, and be kind to your brothers and sisters.
When we help at home, we are serving our family. Mom and Dad work hard to take care of us, and we can help them!
Being a helper at home makes God happy! Every time you help without being asked, you are showing God's love to your family.
activity: Make a 'Helper Chart' with pictures of things you can do at home: pick up toys, make your bed, help with dishes, feed a pet. Check off each thing you do this week!
discussion: What is one way you can help at home?
Who did Jesus say is the greatest person?
How does helping at home make God happy?
